subject: new saveImage options: pdf and svg

messages.author: aba808a7b471253f
messages.subject: new saveImage options: pdf and svg
parts:
Thanks to prompting from Robert Flight and CytoscapeRPC hooks from Jan, new options to the RCytoscape 'saveImage' method are now available:


saveImage (cw, filename, 'pdf|png|svg', scale=1.0)

The 'scale' parameter is only meaningful for png images; in that case, it specifies the magnification for your network view before it is rasterized.

When saving to pdf and svg images, that parameter is ignored. Because RCy now provides a default value, it need not be in your function call:


saveImage (cw, 'xxx.pdf', 'pdf')
saveImage (cw, 'zzz.svg', 'svg')
saveImage (cw, 'yyy.png', scale=2.0)


The only updates Bioconductor permits for released packages are bug fixes. So version 1.4.1 does not contain the new saveImage options.

The changes ARE in the 'devel' version of RCytoscape, currently version 1.5.2, and with the setCenter bug fix, should be available here tomorrow:

http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/html/RCytoscape.html

However, to actually use the new saveImage options, you need Jan's latest jar, version "1.8 testing". Please let us know if you would like a copy.

Cheers!

- Paul
